+'use client'
+
+import { createContext, useContext, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
+
+interface AppContextValue {
+  theme: string
+  setTheme: (theme: string) => void
+}
+
+const AppContext = createContext<AppContextValue | null>(null)
+
+export function AppProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
+  const [theme, setTheme] = useState('light')
+
+  return (
+    <AppContext.Provider value={{ theme, setTheme }}>
+      {children}
+    </AppContext.Provider>
+  )
+}
+
+export function useAppContext(): AppContextValue {
+  const context = useContext(AppContext)
+  if (!context) {
+    throw new Error('useAppContext must be used within AppProvider')
+  }
+  return context
+}

+import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
+import type { ApiPost, CreatePostBody } from '@/types'
+
+const posts: ApiPost[] = [
+  { id: 1, title: 'First Post', content: 'This is the first post' },
+  { id: 2, title: 'Second Post', content: 'This is the second post' },
+]
+
+export async function GET() {
+  return NextResponse.json(posts)
+}
+
+export async function POST(request: Request) {
+  const body = (await request.json()) as CreatePostBody
+  const { title, content } = body
+
+  if (!title || !content) {
+    return NextResponse.json(
+      { error: 'Title and content are required' },
+      { status: 400 }
+    )
+  }
+
+  const newPost: ApiPost = {
+    id: Date.now(),
+    title,
+    content,
+    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+  }
+
+  return NextResponse.json(newPost, { status: 201 })
+}

+import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
+import type { ApiPost, UpdatePostBody } from '@/types'
+
+interface RouteContext {
+  params: Promise<{ id: string }>
+}
+
+export async function GET(_request: Request, { params }: RouteContext) {
+  const { id } = await params
+
+  const post: ApiPost = {
+    id: parseInt(id, 10),
+    title: `Post ${id}`,
+    content: `This is the content for post ${id}`,
+    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+  }
+
+  return NextResponse.json(post)
+}
+
+export async function PUT(request: Request, { params }: RouteContext) {
+  const { id } = await params
+  const body = (await request.json()) as UpdatePostBody
+  const { title, content } = body
+
+  const updatedPost: ApiPost = {
+    id: parseInt(id, 10),
+    title: title ?? `Post ${id}`,
+    content: content ?? `Updated content for post ${id}`,
+    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+  }
+
+  return NextResponse.json(updatedPost)
+}
+
+export async function DELETE(_request: Request, { params }: RouteContext) {
+  const { id } = await params
+
+  return NextResponse.json({ message: `Post ${id} deleted successfully` })
+}

content.text:
Migration is complete. The `pages` directory has been removed and the project builds successfully with the App Router.

## Migration Summary

### Layout & global setup
- **`_app.js` + `_document.js`** → `app/layout.tsx` with `metadata`, global styles, `AppProvider`, and shared header/footer
- **`_error.js`** → `app/error.tsx` (client error boundary with `reset()`)
- **`404.js`** → `app/not-found.tsx` with metadata API

### Pages
| Pages Router | App Router | Pattern |
|---|---|---|
| `pages/index.js` | `app/page.tsx` | `getServerSideProps` → async Server Component + `headers()` |
| `pages/blog/index.js` | `app/blog/page.tsx` | `getStaticProps` + ISR → `export const revalidate = 60` |
| `pages/blog/[id].js` | `app/blog/[id]/page.tsx` | `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams`; `getStaticProps` → async fetch + `notFound()` |

Client interactivity (`useRouter`, buttons) lives in typed client components: `HomePageClient`, `BlogIndexClient`, `BlogPostClient`.

### API routes
| Pages Router | App Router |
|---|---|
| `pages/api/posts/index.js` | `app/api/posts/route.ts` (`GET`, `POST`) |
| `pages/api/posts/[id].js` | `app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts` (`GET`, `PUT`, `DELETE`) |

Uses `NextResponse` and typed request/response bodies.

### Types
Added `types/index.ts` with `Post`, `Comment`, `ApiPost`, `CreatePostBody`, and `UpdatePostBody`. `AppProvider` is now `components/AppProvider.tsx` with a typed context.

### API replacements
- `next/head` → `metadata` / `generateMetadata`
- `next/router` → `next/navigation` (`useRouter`)
- `getServerSideProps` → Server Components + `headers()`
- `getStaticProps` / `getStaticPaths` → `generateStaticParams`, `revalidate`, `notFound()`
- Pages API handlers → Route Handlers with named HTTP method exports

Build output confirms all routes are served from `app/` only.
